assessment.diversity_evidence: All stories share the same premise and nearly identical wording: Nia wants to play a duet, Mateo initially refuses, and she chooses a solo. Most (s000028, s000058, s000023, s000036, s000017, s000053, s000048, s000002, s000035, s000018) add Mateo’s later invitation to play privately; others have Nia accept his choice (s000014, s000034, s000057, s000039, s000024, s000038, s000007, s000041), while s000021 and s000042 repeat his refusal. These are minor outcome branches of one narrow setup, with little meaningful variation in language or ending.
